description: Field definitions for EmissionEvent records (Chapter plan section X.4). This document's keccak256 hash is registered in the on-chain OntologyRegistry, so version 1.0.0 can never be silently redefined.

fields.productId: uint256 - passport NFT id of the product instance
fields.actor: address - permissioned account that recorded the event
fields.activityData: uint256 - physical activity quantity, fixed-point x1000
fields.activityUnit: string - unit of activityData (kg, kWh, tonne-km, m2)
fields.emissionFactor: int256 - gCO2e per activity unit, fixed-point x1000; negative = avoided-burden credit
fields.efSource: string - emission-factor source citation with version
fields.co2eGrams: int256 - computed ON-CHAIN as activityData * emissionFactor / 1e6
fields.methodology: string - accounting methodology label (e.g. GHG Protocol category)
fields.evidenceHash: bytes32 - keccak256 of the off-chain evidence document
fields.prevEventHash: bytes32 - hash of this product's previous event (0x0 for genesis)
fields.schemaVersion: string - version of this schema document
fields.eventHash: bytes32 - keccak256 over all fields above
